purpose: solver completion is not equivalent to physics-truth validity

scope.output_boundary: writes only new derived audit artifacts

auto_shutoff_initial_reference.provenance: Lumerical p0 logs record Auto Shutoff: 1 at simulation start; this is a solver-provided reference, not a new physical threshold

late_window.rule: last ceil(N/3) recorded auto-shutoff samples, minimum 3 samples
late_window.provenance: deterministic post-run sampling rule; it changes no solver physics

late_time_divergence.invalid_when: trajectory first decays below 1.0 and later returns above 1.0, with positive net late-window growth
late_time_divergence.provenance: BF08 attempt_003 logs show post-decay return/growth to 2367.4 (x) and 1.64048 (y), whereas accepted BF07 controls finish near 1e-3

sourcepower_zero.provenance: only exact zero is used as an absolute collapse criterion because sourcepower scale is unit/context dependent

passive_transmission_control_envelope_ma.provenance: maximum absolute formal transmission across frozen accepted BF01-BF07 x/y controls in lp_bf08_attempt003_measurement_forensic_v1; screening signal only unless paired with convergence failure

layers.gate_1_solver_convergence: read immutable solver log; record final/peak/trajectory and classify late-time divergence
layers.gate_2_late_time_energy: use solver auto-shutoff trajectory as the available time-resolved electromagnetic-energy/residual proxy; explicitly report when no independent time-series field-energy observable was persisted
layers.gate_3_transmission_sanity: read transmission(T) without transformation; assess finite values, negative persistence, and control-envelope excess
layers.gate_4_source_normalization: read sourcepower at exact formal monitor coordinates; require finite, strictly positive values and min/max >= 0.99

semantics.INVALID_FOR_PHYSICS_TRUTH: convergence/energy invalid, non-finite transmission, source collapse/instability, or convergence-invalid transmission anomaly
semantics.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_NOT_VALIDATED: required completed-output provenance, log, or formal monitor data unavailable
semantics.negative_transmission: diagnostic only; never transformed and only becomes a truth-invalidating signal together with invalid convergence/energy or non-finite data
